title: What Really Happens in the Bermuda Triangle?
description:
The Bermuda Triangle, also known as the Devil’s Triangle, has captured imaginations for decades with stories of vanishing ships and planes, alien abductions, portals to Atlantis, and supernatural curses. But how much of this is fact, and how much is conspiracy theory? In this 200th episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we dive deep into the myths and science of the Bermuda Triangle.

We’ll explore the famous disappearances of Flight 19 (1945) and the USS Cyclops (1918), the role of writers like Charles Berlitz who linked the mystery to Atlantis, and how his storytelling gave birth to the legend. We contrast this with the debunking work of Larry Kusche, who showed that most claims were exaggerations, misreported storms, or outright fabrications.

Scientific explanations point to hurricanes, the Gulf Stream, navigation errors, methane hydrates, and compass variations, rather than alien bases or portals. We’ll also look at parallels with the so-called Dragon’s Triangle near Japan, another Berlitz creation. If you’ve searched for Bermuda Triangle mystery, Flight 19 explained, USS Cyclops, Dragon’s Triangle, conspiracy theories debunked, or scientific truth behind the Devil’s Triangle, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!

Chapters
00:00 – Introduction: My 200th video & the Bermuda Triangle
02:10 – What is the Bermuda Triangle? Location & myths
05:00 – Famous cases: Flight 19 and the USS Cyclops
09:20 – How Charles Berlitz created the Triangle myth
13:00 – Larry Kusche’s research and debunking
16:20 – Natural explanations: storms, currents, and gas hydrates
20:00 – The Dragon’s Triangle off Japan
23:30 – Brandolini’s Law & why conspiracy spreads faster
26:00 – Conclusion: The rational view of the Bermuda Triangle
